open_questions: The seven City of Atlanta PDFs listed under forms_found (opened: false) could not be opened directly in this environment and their text is not indexed in search snippets; open them in a browser to extract verbatim quotes for the remaining gaps.

Homeowner eligibility to pull standalone residential electrical permits (who_may_file) and any residency/affidavit conditions should be verified from https://atlantaga.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/43020/637145012601370000, https://atlantaga.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/62750/638562989000670000, and https://www.atlantaga.gov/Home/ShowDocument?id=9619.

EV charger permit requirements, load calculation method (NEC 220.82 vs. 220.83), any city worksheet, EV charger load factor, and submittal items should be verified from https://atlantaga.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/37302/636658725389330000, https://www.atlantaga.gov/home/showdocument?id=34401, and 'EV Charger Affidavit Form' on https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-planning/zoning-development-permitting-services/applications-forms-and-checklists.

Permit-required scopes and submittal items for subpanels, 240 V appliance circuits, and residential standby generators should be verified from https://atlantaga.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/33210/636500536008370000, https://www.atlantaga.gov/Home/ShowDocument?id=9619, and 'Description of Electrical Permits & Inspections' on https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-planning/zoning-development-permitting-services/applications-forms-and-checklists.

Residential solar PV and battery storage (ESS) plan-review thresholds, sheet size, signature/stamp rules, and city submittal items should be verified from https://atlantaga.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/52522/637764617399370000 as well as 'Submittal Info-Solar Roof Install - Res', 'Building Permit Packet - (Express)', and 'PV - Inspection Checklist' on https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-planning/zoning-development-permitting-services/applications-forms-and-checklists.

The PDFs linked on https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-planning/zoning-development-permitting-services/applications-forms-and-checklists—including 'EV Charger Affidavit Form', 'Electrical Permit Application', 'Description of Electrical Permits & Inspections', 'Contractors Exception', 'Submittal Info-Solar Roof Install - Res', 'Submittal Info-Solar Roof Install - Express', and 'PV - Inspection Checklist'—could not be opened directly to verify their verbatim contents, revision dates, homeowner electrical permit eligibility, or battery energy storage system (ESS) rules.

Georgia Department of Community Affairs announced 2026 Georgia Amendments to the 2023 National Electrical Code effective January 1, 2027 (https://dca.georgia.gov/announcement/2025-12-09/new-codes-jan-2027); as of 2026-11-24, the 2023 NEC with no Georgia amendments remains in effect.

No City of Atlanta-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method (220.82 vs. 220.83 vs. 220.87), EV charger service load factor, or minimum plan sheet size was found on atlantaga.gov.
